claims.claim: Sparse probing recovered a stable set of under one percent of neurons per generator in a frozen BERT-base-uncased encoder on the RAID benchmark.
claims.episode_span: The study applied L1-to-L2 sparse probing to all 9,216 CLS hidden-state dimensions across twelve layers of a frozen BERT-base-uncased encoder on the RAID benchmark. It recovered a stable set of under one percent of neurons per generator that remained consistent across folds and seeds.
claims.source_title: A Mechanistic Study of AI-Text Detection Neurons in Frozen BERT: Sparse Probing and Activation Patching on RAID
claims.supporting_quote: The procedure recovers a stable set of under 1% of neurons per generator, consistent across folds and seeds.

claims.claim: Leave-one-family-out evaluation showed the selected neurons retained 86-94% of the full-feature ceiling on unseen generator families.
claims.episode_span: Leave-one-family-out evaluation showed the neurons retained eighty-six to ninety-four percent of full-feature ceiling on unseen generator families.
claims.source_title: A Mechanistic Study of AI-Text Detection Neurons in Frozen BERT: Sparse Probing and Activation Patching on RAID
claims.supporting_quote: Leave-one-family-out evaluation shows the selected neurons retain 86-94% of the full-feature ceiling on unseen generator families.

claims.claim: The Spotify conversational recommendation agent achieved +14% user listening, +5% weekly active users, and a 5% reduction in skip rate in online A/B tests.
claims.episode_span: Online A/B tests recorded fourteen percent higher user listening, five percent more weekly active users, and a five percent lower skip rate versus the prior session-refinement experience.
claims.source_title: Bootstrapping Conversational Recommendation Agents At Spotify: Synthetic Data Generation and Self-Improvement Loops
claims.supporting_quote: Online A/B tests demonstrate its effectiveness, with +14% user listening, +5% increase in weekly active users, and a 5% reduction in skip rate compared to a prior experience supporting only session refinement.
